WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.net_amount, f.quantity
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_quarter=1
    AND cp.category='Garden' AND cp.subcategory<>'Outdoor Lighting'
),
dupkeys AS (SELECT count(*) AS dup_receipt_line_keys FROM (SELECT receipt_id,line_no FROM sold GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)),
r AS (
  SELECT r.* FROM fact_return_line r WHERE r.sales_line_id IN (SELECT sales_line_id FROM sold)
)
SELECT (SELECT dup_receipt_line_keys FROM dupkeys) AS dup_keys,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM r) AS return_rows, (SELECT count(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM r) AS ret_ids,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM r GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum(quantity_returned) > (SELECT quantity FROM sold WHERE sold.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id))) AS over_returned,
  (SELECT sum(refund_net) FROM r) AS refund_net,
  (SELECT min(return_date) FROM r) AS min_ret, (SELECT max(return_date) FROM r) AS max_ret,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM r WHERE return_date < (SELECT sale_date FROM fact_sales_line x WHERE x.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id)) AS ret_before_sale,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_return_line WHERE sales_line_id NOT IN (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line)) AS orphan_returns,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT return_line_id FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dup_return_ids_all,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM r WHERE refund_net<0 OR refund_net IS NULL) AS neg_or_null

SELECT s.store_id=900 AS is_web, w.status, count(*) AS n, sum(f.net_amount) AS sold_net,
  sum(f.net_amount<=0) AS nonpos, count(DISTINCT r.sales_line_id) AS returned_lines
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id

WITH sold_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, cp.subcategory, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s     ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p   ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp  ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    JOIN dim_date d      ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 1
      AND cp.category = 'Garden' AND cp.subcategory <> 'Outdoor Lighting'
),
refunds AS (
    SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT l.subcategory,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM sold_lines l
LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY return_rate_pct DESC
